changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: lib-jobs adoption (1/3): generalize the JOBS.COURSE_ID foreign key into generic SCOPE_TYPE/SCOPE_ID columns (see lib-jobs DESIGN.md 3.4), and add CREATED_BY_EMAIL (denormalized; no backfill, UI tolerates null) for the library's JobUserProvider. Existing course associations are preserved as SCOPE_TYPE='course'/SCOPE_ID=COURSE_ID before COURSE_ID is dropped.

sql.sql: UPDATE JOBS SET SCOPE_TYPE = 'course', SCOPE_ID = COURSE_ID WHERE COURSE_ID IS NOT NULL
